applied.problem: u × w is a normal only when u and w do not line up, and three points give a plane only when they are not on one line; otherwise u × w is the zero arrow, so the steps as written fail for those cases.
A + t(B − A) is a fraction t of the way from A to B only for t from 0 to 1; other values of t run past B or back behind A, so the sentence as a general rule is too wide.
The t slider moves in quarters, so the dot can sit at points such as (0.25, 1.5, 0); only the named points on the screens have whole or half parts.
